planner_response.task: Fold the visible coral long-sleeved shirt into a compact rectangle.

setup.roles: The coral garment is the sole manipulated object. The wooden tabletop supports folding. Left and right mean image-left and image-right in the high camera.
assumptions: One shirt lies approximately flat, with sleeves extended, neckline away from the robot and hem toward it.
The exposed wooden surface is locally planar. Estimate its plane from calibrated RGB correspondences; do not assume its height.
Initially visible boundaries approximate garment landmarks. Hidden seams, underside geometry, contact, cloth thickness and native success are unavailable.

initial_features.coordinates: Approximate pixels [u,v]; ROIs are [xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax]. Seeds must be replaced after every action.
initial_features.correspondences: Wrist patches correspond semantically to their respective sleeves; no exact initial cross-camera point correspondence is asserted.

algorithm: Mask projected X5 geometry using measured robot state. Segment coral cloth using Lab color and connected contours; retain fresh boundaries and optical-flow patch tracks.
Match synchronized exposed wood texture across calibrated views using bidirectional descriptors, epipolar filtering and triangulation. Robustly fit the support plane.
Use camera-local rays [(u-cx)/fx,-(v-cy)/fy,-1] with the supplied camera-to-environment transforms. Validate triangulation by positive ray distances and reprojection.
Intersect initial supported cloth rays with the plane. During lifting, triangulate matched cloth texture or contour features; never intersect elevated cloth with the table.
Re-estimate cuffs, shoulders, armpits, hem and creases from fresh contours, color patches and temporal associations. Track material identity without transporting a rigid shirt pose.
Estimate position uncertainty from pixel localization, triangulation conditioning and plane-fit residuals. Reject ambiguous correspondences.
processing.scales: A is measured usable jaw aperture from X5 finger geometry and joints; the initial joint readings are approximately 0.044 m per finger. W and H are current unfolded torso width and length. Set m=max(3*sigma_xy,0.12*A), h=max(3*sigma_z,0.35*A). Reject grasp patches narrower than 2*m or outside reachable, collision-checked space.
processing.unsupported: Closure aperture cannot establish capture. Single-view elevated depth, hidden layer alignment, force and exact wrinkle removal remain unsupported.

recipe: Fold the left sleeve inward about the current left shoulder-to-armpit line, grasping its cuff; place the cuff inside the torso below the opposite shoulder.
Repeat for the right sleeve, placing its cuff below the left shoulder.
Fold the left torso third inward about a neckline-to-hem longitudinal line one-third across the torso. Grasp the left shoulder-side edge and left hem corner with both arms.
Fold the right torso third over the center using its shoulder-side edge and hem corner. Re-estimate the existing folded boundary.
Grasp both current hem corners and fold the lower half toward the shoulder edge about the transverse midpoint. Target a rectangle bounded by the folded side edges.

execution.order: For each recipe operation: APPROACH, SEAT, CLOSE, LIFT_TEST, TRANSFER, LOWER, RELEASE, RETREAT_TEST. Advance immediately when the current predicate passes.
execution.actor_interface: English structured text contains only operation identity, current phase, relevant visible features, uncertainty and the fields below. Positions and residuals use environment XYZ in meters; rotation residual is log(R_target*R_current^-1).

phases.APPROACH: Fields: e_xyz=grasp_prepose-current_jaw_center, e_rotation, clearance. Pass when lateral error<=m, height error<=h, and angular error<=atan(m/A).
phases.SEAT: Fields: patch-to-jaw lateral residual, patch overlap fraction, jaw-bottom height above supported patch. Pass when error<=m, overlap>=0.7, and height uncertainty band intersects the patch surface.
phases.CLOSE: Fields: measured aperture and aperture change. Pass after commanded closure stops changing within encoder uncertainty; proceed to active lift regardless of final aperture.
phases.LIFT_TEST: Fields: tool rise, triangulated patch rise, patch/tool displacement mismatch. Pass when tool and patch rise>=h, mismatch<=max(3*sigma_xyz,0.25*h), and the patch remains visibly between jaws across two action-separated frames.
phases.TRANSFER: Fields: freshly estimated held-patch target residual, rotation residual and swept clearance. Targets reflect current material landmarks across the prescribed fold line, adjusted inside the intended footprint by m. Pass at error<=max(m,0.05*W) with valid clearance.
phases.LOWER: Fields: patch height over support, landing overlap, crease deviation. Pass when height<=h, overlap>=0.8, and deviation<=max(2*m,0.08*W).
phases.RELEASE: Fields: measured opening relative to local patch width. Pass when usable opening exceeds patch width plus 2*m.
phases.RETREAT_TEST: Fields: tool separation, released-boundary displacement, target-footprint overlap. Pass after retreat>=h, boundary displacement<=2*m and overlap>=0.8; then advance recipe.

planner_response.recovery: Allow one recovery per operation: open, retreat to verified clearance, and shift the wrist viewpoint within one aperture while preserving table clearance. Recompute geometry and select a broader visible patch on the same cuff or edge; retry once. Missing metric geometry, failed capture or failed retreat after that ends the attempt as incomplete.
planner_response.completion: After the final retreat, require both sleeves inside the folded footprint, paired hem/shoulder edges within max(2*m,0.1*W), and no exposed protrusion larger than that margin. Report visually verified completion or incomplete; do not claim hidden-layer neatness.

provenance.status: Current initial RGB based proposal; not an executed or successful controller
